cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 96; offset-1 members L95, Garchomp and Eternatus offset 2 L96.
chronology_note: Same audit as E0482 (party_vr96_b); two reachable legends (Chi-Yu, Landorus), no window-90 addition used.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Sand Stream on entry, Smooth Rock extends it
Stoutland/Sandslash Sand Rush outspeed the player's lead
Mega Garchomp in slot 3 with Sand Veil
Alolan Dugtrio Sand Force / Sucker Punch

attempts.why: Sand was live at turn 0. Turn 1 Stoutland Protected, Earth Power + a Surging Strikes crit KO'd Tyranitar. Turn 2 doubled Retaliate + Stomping Tantrum focus-fired Urshifu (308, KO); Earth Power took the un-Mega'd Garchomp to 55. Turn 3 Garchomp Mega Evolved and was KO'd by Sucker Punch before acting; Retaliate hit Kangaskhan for 126; a crit Earth Power KO'd Stoutland. Turn 4 High Horsepower + Iron Head KO'd Mega Kangaskhan; Earth Power OHKO'd Alolan Dugtrio. Turn 5 Prankster Tailwind, Earth Power OHKO'd Sandslash before it moved, Dynamax Cannon hit Landorus for 232. Turn 6-7 Eternatus Protected once, then Earth Power OHKO'd it. Faints: Urshifu, Kangaskhan.

strategy_checks.evidence: B_WEATHER_SANDSTORM from turn 0 through the end (7 turns, still raging)
Stoutland moved before Urshifu and Landorus turns 2-3; Sandslash only lost the race to a Prankster Tailwind
turn 2 Retaliate (doubled, ally fainted turn 1) did 308 with Stomping Tantrum to KO Urshifu; turn 3 Retaliate 126
entered in slot 3 as designed; took 289 from Earth Power un-Mega'd (turn 2), Mega Evolved turn 3 and was Sucker Punched before acting; no Sand Veil miss occurred
Iron Head (Sand Force) helped KO Kangaskhan turn 4; Sucker Punch never chosen; OHKO'd by Earth Power
Dynamax Cannon 232 on Landorus turn 5, Protect turn 6, OHKO'd by Earth Power turn 7

protect_ledger.payoff: empty - nothing was aimed at it (both attacks went into Tyranitar)
blocked a lethal Earth Power + Moonblast - good, delay only

protect_summary: 2 Protects: 1 good, 1 empty. Tyranitar's 'couldn't fully protect itself' message on turn 1 reads as Unseen Fist through a Protect that the native latch did not record (chosen shows Crunch); noted, not counted.
ai_notes: Focus fire was consistently correct (Urshifu turn 2, Kangaskhan turn 4). Garchomp Mega Evolving at 55 HP into a Sucker Punch user is the AI not seeing priority; not illegal.
level_change_rationale: Won first try after a real fight with 2 faints (two focus-fire KOs). Keep.
cooler: The sand door works as designed: three sand abilities all mattered and Retaliate's doubled hit was the fight's best moment. Only note: Mega Garchomp in slot 3 arrives while the player still has fresh answers and left the field without a single attack; Sand Veil never got a chance to matter. That is placement, not sets; no change suggested.
legality_notes: Sets legal (Retaliate replacement noted in the dossier).
